# Braids - Safer AI Coding Assistant

Braids is an AI coding assistant and developer tool that keeps simple code changes simple and gives risky changes the care they deserve. It runs locally inside your coding agent.

## Key Features
- Dynamic thresholding: Automatically routes requests to the right level of engineering depth based on risk.
- High Security: Runs locally. No remote service, telemetry, or hidden project state.
- Depth Levels: Ranging from D0 (local, reversible) to D4 (hard to recover, mission-critical).
- Dedicated Skills:
  - `/braids`: Right-size and implement, holding all claims to concrete evidence.
  - `/braids-review`: Engineering review of a diff or PR.
  - `/braids-audit`: Whole repository audit, ranked strictly by consequence and exposure.
  - `/braids-risk`: Adversarial pre-mortem.
  - `/braids-claims`: Maps subjective claims to factual evidence.
  - `/braids-depth`: Set the engineering threshold explicitly.

## Installation
- Claude Code: `claude plugin marketplace add vyas-devgna/braids`
- Codex / OpenCode / Cline / Copilot: `npx github:vyas-devgna/braids <host>`
